data.why: A garage setting, with a cutaway car corner (axle, tire, body) on the left and the air parts popping in on the right. The camera stays on that corner, stepping back wide for the hook and the stakes so nothing is cut off. The rig's moves are now consistent: the car body uses slide moves, and the bag has its own extend moves (sagB, dipB, highB, raiseB) fired on the same cue words.

ideas.idea: swap the steel spring under a car for a rubber bag of air
the bag leaks and goes flat, so the car sags down onto its tire
about 4000 pounds of car now rest on a flat bag
a compressor pumps air down a hose into the bag and the car lifts
the little pump is slow, so after every dip the car stays low
a tank stores pressurized air so the bag refills in seconds
with nothing to stop the air, the bag swells and the car shoots up too high
a valve lets air in or out so the car settles at the right height
the bag itself is called an air spring
the bag, pump, tank and valve together are air suspension
the compressor fills the tank, the valve opens, air lifts the car, then lets it drop
a bag at about 100 psi can lift thousands of pounds
air suspension is not only for show cars
buses, semi trailers and ambulances ride on air springs
add a remote with a height button and a pressure light, then roll the car in
you have built a bagged car, calm and riding at the right height

chain.shows: the air leaks out of the bag and the car body sinks onto its tire
chain.stakes: 4000 pounds of car rest on a flat bag and the frame meets the tire

chain.shows: after a dip the car drops low and the small pump takes minutes to lift it
chain.stakes: the driver is stuck riding low after every bump

chain.shows: the tank pushes air into the bag with nothing to stop it and the car shoots too high
chain.stakes: the car rides too high, bouncing out of control
